method: On the fixed fine state and match chart, replace only development NQC natural-spline matching-row arithmetic with explicit optimization barriers in the Thomas solve, cubic coefficients, and value/first/second derivative evaluation. Keep the original equilibrated NQC solve and physical targets. Compare eager and JIT fits on identical pre-NQC mode inputs, then compare eager corrected modes to the unchanged source method.
interpretation: One fixed-chart NQC control. Passing would justify a frozen whole-waveform candidate, source comparison, multi-case checks, and AD/FD; failing must stay in the feature branch.
